notes.title: UPDATE 1.4 - The Big One
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce this new update. We worked very hard on this one and finally, it's ready. Accordingly, with this update, we'll launch a discount so you can purchase our game with 30% off!!!

What's new:

- New outdoor map
- Huge walls update (over 70 new walls added)
- Updated Math mode
- Fixed full body calibration
- Now you can make your character invisible for MR or other purposes.
- Few minor bugs fixed
- Graphical update

We hope that you'll have a blast playing our game with this new update. :) Don't forget to leave your opinions and suggestions. We read every message and try to make the game better every day. :)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.3 Full Oculus Rift support
notes.notes:
We are constantly working on updating this game. This time we fixed issues that some players had encountered and also made several new additions. So here they are:

○ Oculus Rift support. Now people who own Oculus Rift can play „Fit It“ too. We welcome you to our community! 😊
○ Fixed calibration problems that occurred for kids and short or high people.
○ Fixed pointer bug.
○ Fixed other minor bugs for smoother gameplay.

Stay tuned for upcoming news! We are preparing new huge update. 😊

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2 - Hard mode without trackers; 40 new walls and more -
NO TRACKER UPDATE 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello, we were working very hard on this update so it can reach you before the launch date. And finally, it's done. 

Now you can play the game without trackers too, using only VR headset and controllers. All modes and levels are available to play. There are walls specifically made for this update.

We also tested it with WMR headset and it works great (Oculus coming soon). 

Now all people who have VR headset can try our game.

Hope you will like it.

notes.title: Fit it Beta Update
notes.notes:
Hello, 
first of all, BIG thanks to all beta testers and their opinions and reviews. Beta testers found some bugs that are now fixed and updated.

- Fixed tracker calibration for full body tracking.
- Added restart and menu buttons in the game. So now you can go back or restart without finishing the whole level.
- Minor graphical updates.

We are always open to other suggestions and new ideas ;)
